definitions.definition: Of or relating to the process of selection.

quote.citation: 2016, Xingming Sun, Alex Liu, Han-Chieh Chao, Cloud Computing and Security: Second International Conference, ICCCS 2016, Nanjing, China, July 29-31, 2016, Revised Selected Papers (part 2, page 579)
quote.text: The selective algorithm excludes the redundant classifiers to construct a streamlined ensemble learning.

definitions.definition: (biology) Of or relating to natural selection.
(of a person) choosy, fussy or discriminating when selecting.
(chiefly US, not comparable) Having the authority or capability to make a selection.
Of or relating to the social work approach called selectivity.

quote.citation: 2006, Francis J. Turner, Encyclopedia of Canadian Social Work, page 189:
quote.text: Eligibility criteria form the essence of selective programs and individuals are evaluated using a means test.
